research_rationale: Held original: 30 FR 6381-6382 (1965-05-07 issue), Lyndon B. Johnson, signed 1965-05-06, appointment in the competitive service of certain present and former Foreign Service officers and employees. Route: original_plus_bounded_search. Later instruments attached: EO 12107 (44 FR 1055; signed 1978-12-28, effective 1979-01-01 under its sec. 2-404), whose sec. 2-101 substitutes the Office of Personnel Management for the Civil Service Commission in the orders listed in its sec. 2-101(b), which includes 11219; and EO 12292 (46 FR 13967, signed 1981-02-23, effective as of 1981-02-15 under its sec. 11), whose sec. 6 amends sections 1 and 5 of EO 11219 (officer or employee becomes member; Foreign Service Act of 1980 added). The packet chain also lists EO 9452 of 1944 as an actor; that is not a later event: EO 9452 pre-dates 11219, and the file registered under it is the Federal Register copy of EO 12292, whose sec. 10(a) revokes EO 9452, not EO 11219. The sec. 10 revocation list of EO 12292 does not name EO 11219. Current-law: the held 5 CFR 315.606 (noncompetitive appointment of Foreign Service officers and employees) applies where the person qualifies under the requirements set forth in Executive Order 11219, and the held 5 CFR 315.201 refers to appointments under Executive Order 11219 as amended by Executive Order 12292. Searches current-law:usc, current-law:ecfr and later-events:ofr_catalog were read for their recorded coverage; none supplies an ending. The dossier inventory was corrected (it stopped at section 2(b)(3), had a mislabeled duplicate, and omitted the lead and sections 2(a), 3, 4 and 5; section 2(a) was also folded into 1(d)). The held original is the Federal Register scan text.
savings_reason: Appointments already made under section 1 are accrued effects of the exercise of the authority; the person appointed holds the status and tenure conferred by sections 2 and 3 as a result of the appointment. The standing authority to appoint continues, so the order itself is not spent. No revocation of EO 11219 and no ending of those appointments was found in the held sources or the bounded searches.
earlier_end_check: No earlier end: the order has no duration or own-terms end; EO 12107 and EO 12292 amend it (change of agency name; Foreign Service Act of 1980 references) and neither revokes it; the revocation list in EO 12292 sec. 10 omits it.
scope_check: Complete inventory re-derived from the held text: lead, section 1 lead, 1(a)-(d), 2(a), 2(b) lead, 2(b)(1)-(3) with the trailing 30-day proviso, and sections 3, 4 and 5.
independent_command_check: Section 1 is the independent authority to appoint; sections 2 and 3 attach tenure and status to the appointment; section 4 applies disqualifying rules; section 5 defines Foreign Service membership. Each is operative while section 1 is. The 30-day proviso to 2(b) conditions credit for Foreign Service time and has no separate end.
savings_check: Accrued status and tenure would survive any later end; none found. The CSC-to-OPM substitution (EO 12107) and the 1980 Act amendments (EO 12292) are amendments, not savings events.
